Name: Symbiosis
Effect: The first time this Pokémon increases one of its Attributes, increase the same Attribute for One Ally. Additionally, if an allied Pokémon loses or spends its Held Item, this Pokémon will immediately give the one it's Holding to the allied Pokémon as a Free Action.
Description: This Pokémon enjoys forming a mutually-beneficial relationship with any ally it teams up with.
